notes_for_editor: The April 21, 2019 Register visit report is the newest condition record found; the standing status rests on that visit, and no later check exists. The Forest Lookouts Grove Hill page holds only a header (name, county, agency). Elevation conflict: Register 495 ft (151 m) vs TopoQuest 485 ft MSL. Build year, builder and model are absent from every source read; two web searches turned up no Alabama Forestry Commission record for Grove Hill. The access level restricted is inferred from the office location, not from a stated rule. The Register page credits a 2019 photo to Andrew Zerbe, but no image URL was extracted, so no photos entry. Do not encourage visits to the office grounds. The story no longer says the TopoQuest source is a map database; it cites only the elevation.
